purpose: Designs target determination, DLID embedding, and ToC construction: input and output boundaries, argument rules, change-set detection, candidate confirmation, and write units.
summary: Inputs and outputs of ToC construction and the execution boundary following the build states
Target determination: argument combination rules, directory and pattern expansion, exclusions, path normalization, symlinks
ID checks: documents without IDs or with duplicate IDs are excluded and reported
DLID embedding operation: duplicate original confirmation, issuing IDs for documents and sections, count-only results
ID issuance spec: 60-bit random Crockford Base32, 12 characters, probabilistic uniqueness, no rollback of verified writes
Change-set determination at document and section level (added, removed, moved, heading change, body change)
Information acquisition: reuse of unchanged document info, AI generation only when needed, candidate validation
Write units: atomic replace of document info and ToC, no locking, partial failure behavior
Completion and rerun: failure diagnostics and re-evaluation from confirmed ToC
tasks: Implementing target expansion and exclusion logic
title: DES-005 対象確定・DLID 付与・[ToC]構築設計
